<@ba.acrem>If this [Laterano] Alliance Operator also equips "Laterano Bridge Clip", bullet damage becomes <@ba.vup>300%</> ATK</>

<@ba.acrem>If this [Aegir] Alliance Operator also equips "Aegir Greatblade", deals an additional hit of Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>50%</> ATK when taking damage (at most once every 0.5s)</>

RES <@ba.vup>+50</>; if the holder is a [Kjerag] Alliance Operator, enemies within its Attack Range afflicted by <$ba.cold>Cold</> or <$ba.frozen>Freeze</> take Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>30%</> of its ATK every second
<@ba.acrem>If this [Kjerag] Alliance Operator also equips "Kjerag Unmelting Ice", the Arts damage per second to <$ba.cold>Cold</> or <$ba.frozen>Frozen</> enemies within its Attack Range increases to <@ba.vup>100%</> ATK</>
